identity_split.leakage_rule: Every canonical and gallery image inherits exactly one identity split; image-level splitting is forbidden.

label_interpretation: Independent Matchmaker editorial judgments; not scientific ground truth, objective beauty, or universal consensus.

known_holdout_exposure.reason: Required baseline gallery audit reported the arithmetic-mean holdout before alternative aggregators were evaluated.
known_holdout_exposure.consequence: Treat this as a reused locked benchmark, not a pristine never-viewed cohort; change no candidate definition or threshold after holdout output.

candidates.rule: Finite raw from the canonical roster portrait; otherwise identity refusal.
Arithmetic mean of all finite gallery raws; otherwise identity refusal.
Median of all finite gallery raws; otherwise identity refusal.
If n>=3, remove exactly one minimum and maximum then arithmetic-mean the remainder; if n=1 or n=2, arithmetic mean; if n=0, identity refusal.

comparison_cohorts.primary: Fixed phase identities with finite predictions from every locked candidate.
comparison_cohorts.operational: Every identity in the phase, with refusal reported for each candidate.

demographic_policy.empty_result_rule: State explicitly that no group meets the support threshold.

display_remap_note: A monotone display remap cannot improve either primary ordering metric.
